status: planned; no features or training yet
source: Author balanced train CSV, SHA256 41a144a904c3080a1683425b7dccee9815b17cf8a6a317b397bab9abbee64ca0; 5544 rows. No author dev/test supervision.
model: Both original 8B backbones frozen; final nonpad hidden vector of literal raw text, no LM logits or temporary code residual.
input: P=supp_set and H=conclusion verbatim; preserve entity markers; no ori_conclusion, PMID, label or mutation type in text; add_special_tokens=True, no chat template, no truncation.

split.unit: Connected components under same PMID OR normalized complete premise OR normalized complete hypothesis. P normalization casefold+whitespace+terminal periods; H casefold+whitespace only.
split.stratification: sklearn 1.7.2 train_test_split on components, stratify by sorted set of author label_cat within component; no model score enters split.
split.update: Original P+PMID plan expanded before split to include duplicate H to prevent H-only same-text leakage; actual two duplicate-H groups already share P, so component count stays 5542.

training.standardization: Separate per view/backbone StandardScaler fit on internal train rows only; reuse training mean/scale for validation and future J. Zero-variance scale=1 per sklearn.
training.selection: Lowest stable validation NLL over converged grid fits; exact tie smaller C. No retraining on train+val after selection; fixed selected trained model remains.
training.label_map: pos->1 (positive), every other supplied author mutation type->0 (negative)
training.threshold: margin>=0, equivalently p(positive)>=0.5, selects positive. No threshold tuning.
training.loss: Ordinary unweighted binary cross entropy with sklearn L2 inverse strength C; no paired consistency or new robust loss.

reports: internal train/val stable NLL, accuracy, balanced accuracy, confusion, per mutation type
convergence warning/iteration count and all three grid fits
P/H vs H-only same split and selection rule
J: 112 inputs may have features extracted now; no J label or correctness used for fitting or selection. J score reporting deferred to next step.
D: No D feature extraction, training or output access.
controls: P/H and H-only, plus later unchanged full K/old combined/task-scope untrained comparisons on J. Better than H-only is necessary to support P-use, not sufficient for broad causal reasoning.
limits: This is supervised linear probing/adaptation of original frozen representations, not an original learning algorithm or exact reproduction of author PubMedBERT/BioLinkBERT fine-tuning. Prior dev overlap and negative experiments retained.
